 Colombia 0 – 0 7:00 PM ET Chile Live Updated 3 minutes ago Kick-off in 20 minutes Colombia vs Chile LIVE, Latest Score, Goals and Friendly Updates
 Follow Colombia vs Chile live score at Estadio Olímpico Pascual Guerrero, goals, team news, lineups, text commentary & Friendly Match 2026 stats on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Daniel Medina Pérez Updated November 13, 2026, 6:37 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 7:00 PM ET Last update 6:37 PM ET 6:37 PM ET 3 minutes ago A new chapter begins for Colombia and Chile
 Both national teams approach this match with their eyes on the future, beginning a new cycle that features several fresh faces in their squads. The clash at the Pascual Guerrero Stadium offers players an opportunity to showcase their abilities and start earning a place in their respective national teams.
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 Follow VAVEL on Google 6:34 PM ET 6 minutes ago Welcome to Colombia vs. Chile!
 International football takes center stage in Cali, the Sultana del Valle. Colombia face Chile at the Pascual Guerrero Stadium in another exciting international fixture. Los Cafeteros will look to make the most of their home support, while the visitors aim to put up a strong fight and secure a positive result.
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 6:34 PM ET 6 minutes ago Recent meetings between Colombia and Chile
 Across their last 2 official clashes, per the historical Colombia vs Chile results and live stats , the balance stands at 1 win for Colombia, 1 draw and 0 wins for Chile:
 2024: Colombia 4–0 Chile
 2023: Chile 0–0 Colombia
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 6:34 PM ET 6 minutes ago Fun fact: three debutants in a list with a European identity
 Among the three players called up to the Colombia national team for the first time, two play in Italy (Juan Arizala at Udinese and Daniel Mosquera at Hellas Verona) and one in Poland (Camilo Mena at Korona Kielce). With them, Lorenzo looks to broaden the team’s base ahead of the qualifiers and the 2028 Copa América.
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 6:15 PM ET 25 minutes ago Key player of Chile
 For the visitors, keep a close eye on Ben Brereton , the striker who is expected to be La Roja’s main attacking reference. Alongside him, Darío Osorio adds speed down the wings and captain Guillermo Maripán leads a defense that will have to deal with the pressure of the Cali crowd.
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 5:41 PM ET an hour ago Key player of Colombia
 The player to watch for the hosts is Jhon Arias , the midfielder who has established himself as one of the national team’s midfield figures and who will be tasked with generating play in the absence of Luis Díaz. Alongside him, striker Luis Suárez, of Sporting, will be one of the main attacking references.
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 5:16 PM ET an hour ago The match will be played at the Estadio Olímpico Pascual Guerrero
 The Colombia vs Chile match will be played at the Estadio Olímpico Pascual Guerrero , located in the city of Cali , in Colombia . This stadium, inaugurated in 1937 , has a capacity for 35,405 spectators.
 It is the home of Deportivo Cali and América de Cali , and tonight it hosts the Colombia national team in a match with a special component: all ticket revenue will go to those affected by the August 10 earthquake.
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 4:49 PM ET 2 hours ago How to watch Colombia vs Chile Live Stream on TV and Online?
 If you want to watch the game Colombia vs Chile live on TV, your options are: Caracol TV and Canal RCN in Colombia, and Mega in Chile.
 If you want to directly stream it: YouTube , Ditu and the Canal RCN app , all free of charge.
 If you want to watch it on the internet, VAVEL is your best option!
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 4:25 PM ET 2 hours ago Follow Colombia vs Chile Live Score with VAVEL!
 We will soon share with you the starting lineups for the Colombia vs Chile live match, as well as the latest information from the Estadio Olímpico Pascual Guerrero. Don’t miss a single detail of the live match updates and commentary from VAVEL’s coverage.
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 4:00 PM ET 3 hours ago Hello to all VAVEL readers!
 Welcome to the live broadcast of Colombia vs Chile , an international friendly of the November FIFA window. The match will take place at the Estadio Olímpico Pascual Guerrero, at 7:00 PM ET.
 My name is Daniel Medina and I will be your host for this match. We will bring you pre-match analysis, score updates and live news here on VAVEL.
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 4:00 PM ET 3 hours ago Colombia vs Chile history
 The most recent precedent dates back to October 15, 2024, when Colombia won 4-0 at the Roberto Meléndez Metropolitano Stadium in Barranquilla, in the South American qualifiers for the 2026 World Cup. These two friendlies are the first meetings between the two sides since then. Colombia and Chile will meet again on Tuesday, November 17 at the Estadio Nacional in Santiago, in the second match of the FIFA window.
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 4:00 PM ET 3 hours ago Chile: Córdova’s La Roja looks to consolidate its project
 The Chile national team, managed by Nicolás Córdova , also presented a list of 26 players for this double date, including Lawrence Vigouroux, Guillermo Maripán, Gabriel Suazo, Williams Alarcón, Felipe Loyola, Darío Osorio, Gonzalo Tapia and Ben Brereton. It is the close of La Roja’s 2026 calendar, a year in which the Chilean team remains in a rebuilding phase ahead of the South American qualifiers for the 2030 World Cup. Tonight the visiting side will face the hosts with a lineup expected to keep its tactical versatility, an aspect that Lorenzo himself highlighted as the big challenge for his team.
 Live updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 4:00 PM ET 3 hours ago Colombia: Lorenzo closes the year trying out new faces
 The Colombia national team, managed by Argentine coach Néstor Lorenzo , closes its 2026 calendar with two friendlies against Chile, its first year-end after a World Cup in which it was eliminated in the round of 16 by Switzerland. Lorenzo called up 26 players, with three debutants: left-back Juan Arizala (Udinese), and forwards Daniel Mosquera ( Hellas Verona ) and Camilo Mena (Korona Kielce). Center-back Davinson Sánchez , of Galatasaray, heads the list. Among the absences are Luis Díaz, with a muscle injury, Richard Ríos, Jaminton Campaz (replaced by Óscar Cortés), Juan Camilo “Cucho” Hernández and Kevin Viveros. Álvaro Montero and Kevin Castaño were not called up because they will play the Copa Sudamericana final.
